cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Know the Procedure
cards.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're kneeling by the cupboard; I'll take the other side. Floor search first. Who has the key? We need that raffle tin.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm tying my shoe. The cleaner has the only key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shoes secure, good. Where does our keyholder go after cleaning?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception. But the tin never went in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we've eliminated that location. Where did you last see it? I'll establish the next search area.
